blocks.text: ATLANTA — Angel Reese and the Atlanta Dream are halfway toward their ultimate goal of winning the franchise’s first WNBA championship. They know there is still work to do. But with a huge Atlanta crowd behind them and Reese dominating the last two games, there’s reason to believe in a team that never even had a WNBA Finals win until this series. READ: WNBA: Angel Reese determined to lead something special for Dream Reese had 21 points and 12 rebounds to help the Dream beat the Golden State Valkyries 97-71 on Wednesday night and take a 2-1 lead.
